# Enhanced Console

> Unity Editor console window for Unity 6 that runs beside Unity's Console: section-based log filtering by name or regex, search across messages and stack traces, collapse modes, log timestamps, clickable stack traces, multi-select and copying logs with or without stack traces. Editor-only, no dependencies, no logging API required. MIT licensed, pre-release (0.x), single author, no other users yet.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/sgonzalezrozo/unity-enhanced-console/blob/main/README.md): installation, quick start, API, troubleshooting, FAQ
